meta.title: 英语听力播客 · Autumn（秋天）精读
meta.subtitle: Listening Time Podcast · Bonus Episode: Autumn（主播 Conner）· 全文 223 句 / 3228 词
meta.summary:
这是一期面向英语学习者的"讲解型播客"逐字稿，主题是美国的秋天（autumn / fall）。主播 Conner 先用大半段介绍节目形式和 Patreon 会员福利，然后进入正题：先纠正 autumn 的发音（是 "aw"，不是 "oh"），再讲秋天的天气——气温下降（the temperature drops）、早晚清爽（crisp）、有点凉（chilly）；接着讲树叶变色和美国人赏秋的传统（take a trip to see the colors）。后半段是重头戏——美国的秋季传统：去南瓜农场（pumpkin patch）挑南瓜、坐干草车（hay ride）、走玉米迷宫（corn maze）；菜单上的秋季食物——南瓜拿铁（pumpkin spice latte）、南瓜派、山核桃派、苹果酒（apple cider）；以及感恩节（Thanksgiving）的由来、"说出你要感谢的一件事"的传统、之后的黑色星期五（Black Friday）打折季，最后是圣诞音乐与"节日季"（holiday season）的开始。

本期最大的学习价值是"用英语解释英语"：主播几乎每遇到一个生词都会停下来解释，比如 "Chilly just means a little bit cold"、"The word 'hype' is used to talk about excitement"。这类句型本身就是最值得模仿的口语表达。

说明：这份 PDF 只有英文原文（没有中文对照），所以页面隐藏了中文开关并标注"纯英文原文"；中文讲解都在生词卡、语法点和练习里。
learningFocus: 天气词汇三兄弟：chilly / crisp / cool（都是"有点冷"，但语感不同）
释义句型：In English, when we say…, it just means… / The word X refers to…
农场与游乐词汇：pumpkin patch, hay ride, wagon, tractor, corn maze, dead end
食物与饮品：pumpkin spice latte, pecan pie, apple cider, cinnamon, beverage
节日与购物：Thanksgiving, day off, get together, Black Friday, deal, discount
短语动词的宾语位置：point it out（不说 point out it），以及 pull/push 这类反义动词
studyPlan: 第 1 步（10 分钟）：通读「逐句精读」第 17–68 句，这是天气与树叶变色的主体段落，先不看中文（本来也没有），用上下文猜词。
第 2 步（12 分钟）：过「生词」卡片并跟读例句；重点记主播亲口解释过的词（chilly, crisp, distinct, hype, harsh）。
第 3 步（10 分钟）：读「语法点」，把"用英语解释英语"的释义句型和短语动词的宾语位置练熟。
第 4 步（10 分钟）：用「句型模板」自己介绍一个中国传统节日（模仿 Black Friday / Thanksgiving 的讲法）。
第 5 步（12 分钟）：做「练习」，翻译题先自己写；写完后对照原文句子，看自己漏了哪个搭配。
第 6 步（10 分钟）：回到第 83–120 句（南瓜农场与玉米迷宫），用 0.85× 跟读，注意主播的停顿与重音。

vocab.zh: 额外的好处；附加的（节目、内容）
vocab.note: 本期是 "bonus podcast episode"（会员专属加更）。主播自己解释：bonus just means something extra。常见搭配：a bonus episode / a bonus point（附加分）。

examples.en: So, if you don't know what the word "bonus" means, this just means something extra.

vocab.note: mis-（错误）+ pronounce（发音）。名词 mispronunciation。主播说他常听到这个词被读错：I hear this word mispronounced all the time。

examples.en: I hear this word mispronounced all the time, so, I wanted to point that out.

vocab.note: 形容词 traditional，副词 traditionally。本期反复出现：traditions surrounding the autumn season、another tradition in the fall。

examples.en: So, I'll talk a little bit more about the season, and I'll talk about some of the traditions surrounding the autumn season in the US.
So, this is a really cool tradition that we have.

vocab.note: 程度比 cold 轻。主播直接给了定义：Chilly just means a little bit cold. 注意与 chili（辣椒）拼写只差一个字母。

examples.en: So of course, this season is the season where it starts to get a little bit chilly.
"Chilly" just means a little bit cold.

vocab.zh: （空气、天气）清爽微凉的；酥脆的
vocab.note: 同一个词两个常用义：a crisp morning（清爽的早晨）／crisp chips（酥脆的薯片）。主播说 crisp 是 chilly 的另一种说法：a little bit cold。

examples.en: And the mornings and the evenings tend to be crisp.
So, we like to say "a crisp morning" for example.

vocab.note: 主播的解释最直白："distinct" just means different。distinct seasons 四季分明的季节。名词 distinction，副词 distinctly。

examples.en: if you live in a region where there are distinct seasons, you probably see the colors change during September, October, around that time.

vocab.note: the whole landscape change 整片景色改变。引申义：the political landscape（政治格局）。

examples.en: So, during this time of year, you start to see the whole landscape change.

vocab.note: 本义是"大气层"，日常多用引申义"氛围"：the autumn atmosphere（秋天的氛围）。形容词 atmospheric。

examples.en: they might even take some type of vacation or trip to a beautiful place to see these colors and see the autumn atmosphere.

vocab.note: ＝ one part of a situation。常用搭配：a lot of people like this aspect of fall（很多人喜欢秋天的这一点）。

examples.en: So, a lot of people really like this aspect of fall.

vocab.zh: 南瓜农场／南瓜地（秋天供人挑选南瓜的地方）
vocab.note: patch 本义是"小块地、菜地"，所以 pumpkin patch 就是"种南瓜的那片地"。主播解释：a place where you can go with your family and they have a lot of pumpkins growing。

examples.en: If you've never heard of a pumpkin patch, this is a place where you can go with your family and they have a lot of pumpkins growing.

vocab.note: 不可数名词。注意与 straw（麦秸）的区别：hay 是喂牲口的草料，straw 多用于铺垫或编织。

examples.en: So, the word "hay" refers to that yellow grass that you feed to farm animals, like horse(s), cattle, sheep, etc.

vocab.note: 主播专门强调：The word "cattle" is always plural. 所以不能说 a cattle，要说 a cow（一头牛）／cattle（一群牛）。

examples.en: So, when we talk about cows, we sometimes use the word "cattle" instead.
The word "cattle" is always plural.

vocab.note: 主播解释：a box-like vehicle with wheels… someone has to pull this wagon（没有发动机，得靠别的东西拉）。hay ride 就是坐在装满干草的 wagon 上。

examples.en: The word "wagon" refers to this kind of box-like vehicle with wheels... usually big wheels, and someone has to pull this wagon.

vocab.note: pull 与 push（推）是一对反义动词。本期还用到了 pull 的引申义：pull it off（成功做到）。

examples.en: So, the word "pull" is just the opposite of push, right.
So, you have to pull this wagon in order for it to move.

vocab.note: 干草车通常由 tractor（或卡车）牵引：there's usually a tractor or some type of truck that pulls this wagon。

examples.en: So, on this hay ride, there's usually a tractor or some type of truck that pulls this wagon full of hay

vocab.note: 与 maze 近义，但 labyrinth 更强调"进去难出来"的复杂结构。主播用 it refers to like a labyrinth 来解释 maze。形容词 labyrinthine。

examples.en: So, the word "maze" refers to like a labyrinth... something, some structure where you have to find the exit, right.

vocab.zh: 死路，走不通的一头；僵局
vocab.note: 字面是"路的尽头"，引申指"没有出路的境地"：The talks reached a dead end.（谈判陷入僵局。）

examples.en: A "dead end" just means that it's a place where you can't go through.
there are many dead ends and many left and right turns, and you have to find your way out of this maze.

vocab.note: You're trying to escape and find the exit. 名词也是 escape：a narrow escape（死里逃生）。不要与 escape 拼成 excape。

examples.en: You're trying to escape and find the exit.

vocab.note: 主播解释：something where you sit on the machine and it moves you around。迪士尼里的"项目"也叫 rides；give sb a ride 则是"载某人一程"。

examples.en: The word "ride" just refers to something where you sit on the machine and it moves you around.

vocab.zh: （旅游、游乐）景点，吸引人的项目
vocab.note: tourist attraction 旅游景点。动词 attract，形容词 attractive。

examples.en: So, there are sometimes rides and other attractions like that at pumpkin patches.

vocab.note: 英式拼写 flavour，美式 flavor（本文是美式）。动词义"给……调味"：flavored with apple and cinnamon（用苹果和肉桂调味）。

examples.en: there are certain flavors that we associate with autumn.
And it's flavored with apple and cinnamon, and so it has a very sweet flavor.

vocab.note: 源自意大利语 caffè latte（牛奶咖啡）。主播解释：a latte, a coffee that has a pumpkin flavor to it。pumpkin spice latte 是美国的秋季国民饮品。

examples.en: So, for example, the most famous drink that you see all over America during the fall is the pumpkin spice latte.

vocab.zh: （媒体、大众的）炒作，热议；大力宣传
vocab.note: 主播解释：we use the word "hype" to talk about excitement。固定说法：see what all the hype is about（看看为什么大家这么追捧）。动词 hype sth up 大力吹捧。

examples.en: In English, we use the word "hype" to talk about excitement.
So, I think this week, I might try and taste this pumpkin spice latte and see what all the hype is about.

vocab.note: 注意与 desert（沙漠，/ˈdezət/）拼写相近、重音不同：dessert 重音在后。pumpkin pie is a big dessert（南瓜派是重要甜点）。

examples.en: This is a big dessert during this time period.

vocab.note: 美国南方常见，读音各地不同（/pɪˈkæn/、/ˈpiːkæn/ 都可以）。感恩节经典甜点是 pecan pie。

examples.en: People start baking pecan pie.
Pecan is a type of nut.

vocab.note: a type of nut（一种坚果）；坚果统称 nuts。注意 peanut 是豆科植物，但日常也归入 nuts 一起说。

examples.en: Pecan is a type of nut.

vocab.note: 美式 apple cider 多指未过滤的苹果汁（可热饮）；英式的 cider 通常指含酒精的苹果酒。主播说它是 warm drink（热饮），很甜。

examples.en: If you don't know what apple cider is, this is a warm drink.

vocab.note: 烘焙与热饮常用香料，与苹果、南瓜是秋季经典搭配。注意拼写里的 -mon，不要写成 cinnamin。

examples.en: And it's flavored with apple and cinnamon, and so it has a very sweet flavor.

vocab.note: 菜单、酒店里常见（food and beverages 餐饮）。日常口语更常说 drink。

examples.en: This is one of my favorite beverages.

vocab.note: 美国感恩节的招牌主菜。注意大写 Turkey 指国家"土耳其"。主播用两个短句点题：And then of course, turkey. Why? Because: Thanksgiving.

examples.en: And then of course, turkey.

vocab.note: 美式 vacation ≈ 英式 holiday。on vacation 在度假；a four-day vacation 四天假期。注意本文中 holiday 指"节日"（Thanksgiving is a big holiday），不是"假期"。

examples.en: During Thanksgiving, students usually have a four-day vacation.

vocab.note: 主播解释：an event where you eat food。breakfast / lunch / dinner 都是 meals。have a big meal 吃一顿大餐。

examples.en: The word "meal" just refers to an event where you eat food.
I would say that this is probably the biggest meal of the year.

vocab.zh: 严酷的，恶劣的；刺耳的、苛刻的
vocab.note: 主播解释：Harsh just means difficult, extreme conditions。可说 harsh winter / harsh criticism。副词 harshly。

examples.en: Harsh just means difficult, extreme conditions.
they faced very harsh conditions.

vocab.note: 来自 colony（殖民地）。文中讲感恩节由来：the colonists from England arrived in the US in the 1600s（17 世纪来到美洲的英格兰移民）。

examples.en: Well, the story goes that the colonists from England, when they arrived in the US in the 1600s, they faced very harsh conditions.

vocab.note: be thankful for sth 对……心怀感激。名词 thanks / gratitude，动词 thank。感恩节的传统就是每人说一件自己感激的事。

examples.en: one tradition that families have nowadays on Thanksgiving is that everyone will say one thing that they're thankful for.

vocab.note: 主播解释：the word "blessing" just means some good thing in your life。give thanks for the blessings in our lives（感谢生活中的福气）。

examples.en: In English, the word "blessing" just means some good thing in your life.

vocab.note: 本期与 discount 一起出现，都指商家降价：have deals and discounts。另有常用短语 a great deal of（大量）和动词 deal with（处理）。

examples.en: And this is the day where all the stores in the country or almost all the stores have deals and discounts

vocab.note: at a discount 打折；give sb a discount 给某人打折。主播把它和 deal 一起解释成"商店降价"：a store lowers its prices so that the items are cheaper。

examples.en: So, we use the word "deal" and the word "discount" to just talk about when a store lowers its prices so that the items are cheaper.

vocab.note: 文中指播客的付费会员（Patreon 平台上的 patron）。动词 patronize；注意其"资助"义与"光顾"义都可出现。

examples.en: Thank you again for becoming a patron here on Patreon and for supporting this show.

vocab.note: 大学与培训场景高频词：attend a seminar。文中指会员每月可参加一次的 Listening Practice Seminar。

examples.en: you'll also have access to one Listening Practice Seminar every month

phrases.note: ＝ in more detail。主播自己解释了它：We're going to go deeper into the topic. 也说 explore sth in depth。

example.en: I thought this would be a good topic to explore in more depth.
example.zh: 我觉得这是个值得更深入探讨的话题。

phrases.note: 主播的解释：we want to draw your attention to that thing。宾语是代词时必须放中间：point it out ✓ / point out it ✗。

example.en: In English, when we use the phrase "point that out" or "point something out", this just means that we want to draw your attention to that thing.
example.zh: 英语里说 point that out／point something out，意思就是想让对方注意到那件事。

phrases.note: to 是介词，后面跟名词或动名词：look forward to seeing you。主播的解释：we are excited about something that is going to happen in the future。

example.en: In English, when we say "look forward to" something, this just means that we are excited about something that is going to happen in the future.
example.zh: 英语里的 look forward to 就是"对将要发生的事感到兴奋"。

phrases.term: take a trip / take a vacation
phrases.note: take 与 trip/vacation 搭配表示"去一趟"；take a day off 则是"请一天假"。

example.en: they might even take some type of vacation or trip to a beautiful place to see these colors
example.zh: 他们甚至可能专门去一个漂亮的地方度假旅行，就为了看这些颜色。

phrases.zh: 干草车（坐在装满干草的车上兜一圈）
phrases.note: 秋季南瓜农场的经典项目。ride 在这里是名词"乘坐体验"。

example.en: So, this is referred to as a "hay ride" in English.
example.zh: 这在英语里就叫 hay ride（干草车）。

phrases.note: 用高大玉米秆围成的迷宫：a maze with really tall walls of corn。主播说他最喜欢这个项目。

example.en: So, a corn maze is a maze with really tall walls of corn.
example.zh: 玉米迷宫就是用很高的玉米墙围成的迷宫。

phrases.zh: 找到出路，走出（迷宫、困境）
phrases.note: 同族表达：lose one's way（迷路）、find one's way to（辗转到达）。

example.en: you have to find your way out of this maze.
example.zh: 你得自己从这个迷宫里找到出路。

phrases.note: ＝ be called / be known as，但更正式。动词 refer to 还有"指的是、提到"的意思。

example.en: So, this is referred to as a "hay ride" in English.
example.zh: 这在英语里被称为 hay ride。

phrases.term: see what all the hype is about
phrases.zh: 看看（这东西）到底为什么这么受追捧
phrases.note: 口语高频说法：hype 指媒体的热炒。同类：see what the fuss is about。

example.en: I might try and taste this pumpkin spice latte and see what all the hype is about.
example.zh: 我可能会尝尝这款南瓜拿铁，看看它到底为什么这么火。

phrases.note: 频率表达：once a week（每周一次）、twice a month（每月两次）、every other day（每隔一天）。

example.en: I can eat it maybe once or twice a year without having any problems.
example.zh: 我大概一年吃一两次还没问题。

phrases.note: 主播的解释：you gather with other people… go to the same place to spend time together。名词形式 get-together 指"聚会"。

example.en: So, on Thanksgiving, people get together with their families.
example.zh: 所以在感恩节，人们会和家人聚在一起。

phrases.term: a day off / have two days off
phrases.note: 主播的解释：you don't have to go to school or to work on that day。注意是 a day off（不是 a day off work 也可以说）。

example.en: In English, when you say that you have a "day off", this just means that you don't have to go to school or to work on that day.
example.zh: 英语里说 have a day off，就是指那天不用上学或上班。

phrases.note: take turns 轮流：We take turns driving.（我们轮流开车。）in turn 则表示"依次、反过来"。

example.en: So, each person at the table will take a turn and say one thing that they're thankful for
example.zh: 餐桌上的每个人会轮流说一件自己感激的事。

phrases.note: Thanksgiving 这个节日名就来自 give thanks。give thanks for the blessings in our lives。

example.en: The holiday is called Thanksgiving, so we want to give thanks for the blessings in our lives.
example.zh: 这个节日叫感恩节，所以我们要感谢生活中的福气。

phrases.note: 用来转述传说或来源不明的说法，比 It is said that… 更口语。主播用它讲感恩节由来，并补了一句 I don't know how true that is。

example.en: But the story goes that the colonists shared this big meal with the Native Americans in the year 1621, and this was known as the first Thanksgiving.
example.zh: 但据传 1621 年殖民者与印第安人共享了这顿大餐，这被称为第一个感恩节。

phrases.zh: 与……联系在一起，让人联想到
phrases.note: 名词 association。文中指某些口味让人联想到秋天：flavors that we associate with autumn。

example.en: there are certain flavors that we associate with autumn.
example.zh: 有些口味会让我们联想到秋天。

phrases.note: 强调时间跨度不断：from November all the way through to the new year。

example.en: You hear Christmas music everywhere, starting on the day after Thanksgiving, all the way through to the new year.
example.zh: 从感恩节第二天开始，一直到新年，到处都能听到圣诞音乐。

grammar.title: 用英语解释英语：三种释义句型
grammar.structure: X just means Y. / The word X refers to Y. / In English, when we say X, it just means Y.
grammar.explain: 这是本期最值得整体模仿的语言现象：主播每遇到一个可能陌生的词，就立刻用简单英语解释一遍。掌握这三句式，你就能用英语向别人解释中文概念，也是口语考试里"paraphrase（换句话说明）"能力的核心。

examples.en: "Chilly" just means a little bit cold.
The word "wagon" refers to this kind of box-like vehicle with wheels...
In English, we use the word "hype" to talk about excitement.
In English, the word "blessing" just means some good thing in your life.

grammar.caution: 注意三种句型的语域差别：just means 最口语，refers to 偏书面，is defined as 最学术。另外 “In English, when we say X…” 这种起手式非常适合口语展开话题。

grammar.title: 短语动词的宾语位置：point it out
grammar.structure: 动词 + 副词小品词：宾语是名词可放中间或后面；宾语是代词必须放中间
grammar.explain: point out、pick up、turn on 这类"动词 + 副词"的短语动词，代词宾语必须夹在中间。主播在解释 point that out 时用的正好是这个结构。

examples.en: so, I wanted to point that out.
this just means that we want to draw your attention to that thing.
We want to point it out.

grammar.caution: point out it ✗ / point it out ✓；point out the mistake ✓ / point the mistake out ✓（名词两种位置都可以）。

grammar.title: 被动语态：be referred to as / be known as / be considered
grammar.structure: be + 过去分词（+ as / with）
grammar.explain: 介绍名称、定义与习俗时，英语大量使用被动："这被称为……"、"这天被认为是……"、"它用……调味"。施事通常是泛指的"人们"，所以直接省略。

examples.en: So, this is referred to as a "hay ride" in English.
this was known as the first Thanksgiving.
The day after Thanksgiving is considered Black Friday.
And it's flavored with apple and cinnamon

grammar.caution: 三个固定搭配要连介词一起记：be referred to as、be known as、be considered（不加 as 也可以：is considered Black Friday）。

grammar.title: 关系从句：where / that / which 补充说明
grammar.explain: 本期几乎每介绍一个概念都会跟一个关系从句。区分 where（先行词是地点）与 that/which（先行词是物），是听懂长句的关键。

examples.en: if you live in a region where there are distinct seasons
This is the thing that you see during the Halloween season.
This is a little bit similar to pumpkin patches, where you choose your pumpkin for the fall season.
there are certain flavors that we associate with autumn.

grammar.caution: 先行词是地点但从句缺主语时仍用 that/which：the place that I like（不是 where I like）。判断依据是"从句里缺什么成分"。

grammar.title: 现在完成时谈"到目前为止的经历"
grammar.structure: have/has + 过去分词（常与 before、ever、never、always 连用）
grammar.explain: 主播大量用现在完成时讲自己的经历：以前讲过这个话题、从没试过这款饮品、一直看到它打广告。重点是"到现在为止"，不强调具体时间。

examples.en: I've talked a little bit about this before, I think in the episode about seasons
I've actually never tried this before
because I've always seen it advertised during September, October, November
So, I've done these before at pumpkin patches even as an adult.

grammar.caution: 有明确过去时间状语时不能用现在完成时：I tried it last week ✓ / I have tried it last week ✗。

grammar.title: 表目的：in order for sb/sth to do 与 so that 从句
grammar.structure: in order (for sb/sth) to do；so that + 从句
grammar.explain: 同一个目的可以用名词性结构（不定式）或从句（so that）表达。主播讲 wagon 不能自己动、以及感恩节轮流发言时各用了一次。

examples.en: So, you have to pull this wagon in order for it to move.
so that they can give thanks, right.
we use the word "deal" and the word "discount" to just talk about when a store lowers its prices so that the items are cheaper.

grammar.caution: in order to 后接与主句主语一致的动作；主语不一致时要用 in order for sb to do（如第 95 句 for it to move）。

grammar.title: 动词 + 宾语 + to do：motivate / want / ask
grammar.structure: 动词 + sb + to do sth
grammar.explain: 英语里"让某人做某事"常靠这类结构：motivate sb to do（激励）、want sb to do（想要）、ask sb to do（请求）。本期开头主播感谢听众支持时就用了 motivate me to work harder。

examples.en: It really motivates me to work harder and to provide more content for you
this just means that we want to draw your attention to that thing.
I'll talk a little bit more about the season

grammar.caution: 注意区分：want sb to do（想要）／make sb do（强迫，不加 to）／let sb do（允许，不加 to）／hope that sb does（不能接 sb to do）。

grammar.title: 比较与程度：-er than / a little bit / the biggest
grammar.structure: 比较级 + than；a little bit + 形容词；the + 最高级 + of/in
grammar.explain: 描述季节变化时，程度词非常重要：a little bit chilly（有点凉）、colder than summer（比夏天冷）、the biggest meal of the year（一年中最大的一餐）。

examples.en: It's definitely colder than summer.
This just means a morning that's a little bit chilly, a little bit cool.
I would say that this is probably the biggest meal of the year.
But more than that, I think, would be too much for me.

grammar.caution: a little bit 修饰形容词表示"有点儿"，比 very 弱；too much 表示"过量、受不了"，语气比 a lot 负面。

grammar.title: 情态动词：推测（might）与必要（have to / should）
grammar.structure: might + do（可能）；have to + do（必须）；should + do（应该）
grammar.explain: 听播客时抓住情态动词就能分辨"这是事实还是猜测"。主播说南瓜派 might be too strong（可能对某些人来说太冲）、在迷宫里 you have to find the exit（必须找到出口）、you should turn left or right（该左还是该右）。

examples.en: and it might be too strong for some people.
It's very confusing because you don't know if you should turn left or right and there are dead ends.
you have to find the exit just by turning and going

grammar.caution: might 的可能性低于 may 的书面用法，但口语里两者差不多；must 表推测时语气很强（"一定"），而 have to 表义务。

grammar.title: 动名词与不定式作主语、宾语
grammar.structure: v-ing / to do 作主语或宾语
grammar.explain: 主播在讲"挑南瓜"时说 the kids like to decide on which pumpkin looks the best，讲"吃南瓜派"时说 without having any problems——不定式与动名词常常可以互换，但介词后只能用动名词。

examples.en: the kids like to decide on which pumpkin looks the best, and so they have fun choosing a pumpkin.
I can eat it maybe once or twice a year without having any problems.
So, this is something really fun to do with your friends or your kids.

grammar.caution: 介词后面必须用动名词：without having ✓ / without have ✗；enjoy、finish、practice 等动词后也接动名词。

grammar.title: 顺序与时间连接词：播客的"路标"
grammar.structure: first / then / after that / lastly / nowadays / around this time
grammar.explain: 听力理解最怕"不知道讲到哪了"。抓住这些路标词，就能跟上主播的结构：先说天气，再说传统，最后说黑色星期五。

examples.en: Okay, so first let's just talk briefly about the weather, the weather in fall, and then we'll go on to some fall traditions after that.
Okay, let's move on and start talking about some traditions in the US that we have during this season.
And then lastly, I just wanted to mention Black Friday.
one tradition that families have nowadays on Thanksgiving

grammar.caution: 听到 let's move on、that's enough for this episode、lastly 就知道话题要换或节目要收尾，可以据此判断有没有漏听。

patterns.en: So, the first thing I want to talk about is the pronunciation of the word "autumn".
patterns.zh: 所以，我首先要讲的是 autumn 这个词的发音。
patterns.usage: 播客/演讲的开场路标：the first thing I want to talk about is…。听完这句就能预判接下来讲什么。
patterns.rewrite: Let's start with how to pronounce the word "autumn".

patterns.en: But I want to talk a little bit about pumpkin patches.
patterns.zh: 但我想稍微讲讲南瓜农场。
patterns.usage: 换话题的过渡句：I want to talk a little bit about X。a little bit 让语气显得随意、不压迫。
patterns.rewrite: Now let me say a few words about pumpkin patches.

patterns.en: If you've never heard of a pumpkin patch, this is a place where you can go with your family and they have a lot of pumpkins growing.
patterns.zh: 如果你从没听说过 pumpkin patch，那就是一个可以带家人去、种着很多南瓜的地方。
patterns.usage: 假设听众不懂再解释：If you've never heard of X, this is…。写作与口语中都能用，比直接下定义更照顾读者。
patterns.rewrite: A pumpkin patch — in case you haven't come across the term — is a farm where families go to pick pumpkins.

patterns.en: It's kind of like when you choose a Christmas tree before Christmas, and the whole family examines the different options and tries to imagine which tree will look best in the house.
patterns.zh: 这有点像圣诞节前挑圣诞树，全家人比较各种选择，想象哪棵放在家里最好看。
patterns.usage: 类比解释法：It's kind of like when…。用听众熟悉的事去解释陌生的事，kind of 起缓和作用。
patterns.rewrite: Think of it as choosing a Christmas tree — everyone compares the options together.

patterns.en: So, that's something that you don't really find in other countries, but you can find pumpkin patches all over the country in the US.
patterns.zh: 这是你在别的国家不太会见到的东西，但在美国各地都能找到南瓜农场。
patterns.usage: 文化对比句式：that's something that you don't really find in other countries, but…。介绍本国特色时特别好用。
patterns.rewrite: Pumpkin patches are pretty much an American thing, though they're everywhere here.

patterns.en: I would say that this is probably the biggest meal of the year.
patterns.zh: 我会说这大概是一年中最大的一顿饭。
patterns.usage: 表达个人判断的稳妥说法：I would say that… probably…。比直接断言更留有余地，口语与写作都常用。
patterns.rewrite: I'd say it's the biggest meal of the year, without a doubt.

patterns.en: And so you might be asking "Why do you celebrate Thanksgiving in the US?"
patterns.zh: 你可能会问："美国为什么要庆祝感恩节？"
patterns.usage: 自问自答引出下文：you might be asking…，然后自己回答。演讲、播客里用来推进话题的经典手法。
patterns.rewrite: You may wonder why Americans celebrate Thanksgiving.

patterns.en: That's what we're taught in school, and so that's the story that we usually tell about Thanksgiving.
patterns.zh: 这是我们在学校被教的内容，也是我们通常讲的感恩节故事。
patterns.usage: 交代信息来源并保持距离：That's what we're taught…。配合前面 I don't know how true that is，既讲了故事又不把传说当事实。
patterns.rewrite: That's the version we learn at school and repeat every year.

exercises.question: "this season is the season where it starts to get a little bit chilly"（第 42 句）中 chilly 的意思是：
exercises.explain: 主播自己解释了：Chilly just means a little bit cold。程度比 cold 轻。注意别和 chili（辣椒）混淆。

exercises.question: "we like to say 'a crisp morning'"（第 51 句）中 crisp 形容早晨时最接近的意思是：
exercises.explain: crisp 形容天气时指"空气清爽、有点凉"，主播说它相当于 chilly、a little bit cold。crisp 形容食物时则是"酥脆的"。

exercises.question: So of course, the temperature ______ (drop) during this season.（第 45 句，用正确形式填空）
exercises.explain: 主语 the temperature 是第三人称单数，且描述秋季的一般规律，用一般现在时 drops。

exercises.question: 关于 "cattle" 这个词（第 86 句），下面哪个说法正确？
options: 它是集体名词，永远当复数用，不能说 a cattle
它是单数名词，可以说 a cattle
它是不可数名词，不能作主语
exercises.explain: 主播专门强调：The word "cattle" is always plural. 想说"一头牛"要用 a cow，想说"很多牛"可以用 cattle。

exercises.question: I hear this word mispronounced all the time, so I wanted to point ______ out.（第 33 句，填入指代 this word 的代词）
exercises.explain: point out 是"动词 + 副词"的短语动词，宾语是代词时必须放中间：point it out。point out it 是错的。

exercises.question: "In English, we use the word 'hype' to talk about excitement."（第 135 句）中 hype 的意思是：
exercises.explain: hype 指围绕某事物的热烈讨论与期待。文中主播说要尝尝南瓜拿铁，see what all the hype is about（看看它到底为什么这么火）。

exercises.question: So, this ______ (refer) to as a "hay ride" in English.（第 97 句，用被动语态填空）
exercises.explain: be referred to as = 被称为。这是介绍名称时的固定被动结构，后面必须跟 as。

exercises.question: "A 'dead end' just means that it's a place where you can't go through."（第 102 句）在迷宫里，dead end 指的是：
exercises.explain: dead end 字面是"路的尽头"，指前方封死、无法通过的地方；引申义是"僵局"，如 The talks reached a dead end。

exercises.question: I've actually ______ (never / try) this before.（第 133 句，用现在完成时填空）
exercises.explain: 谈"到目前为止的经历"用现在完成时：have never tried。注意不能写成 I never tried this before 作为标准书面表达。

exercises.question: each person at the table will take a turn and say one thing that they're thankful for, ______ that they can give thanks.（第 199 句，填一个词）
exercises.explain: so that + 从句表示目的（"以便……"）。这里完整形式是 so that they can give thanks。

exercises.question: And it's flavored ______ apple and cinnamon, and so it has a very sweet flavor.（第 162 句）
exercises.explain: be flavored with sth 用……调味，介词固定为 with。同类：be filled with、be covered with。

exercises.question: Thanksgiving 期间学生放四天假，第 175 句说 "you have a day off"，这里的 day off 指：
options: 不用上班或上学的休息日
exercises.explain: 主播的解释：you don't have to go to school or to work on that day。复数形式是 two days off。

exercises.question: "they faced very harsh conditions"（第 191 句）中 harsh 的意思是：
exercises.explain: 主播的解释：Harsh just means difficult, extreme conditions。也可形容话语苛刻：harsh criticism。

exercises.question: 翻译成英文：这个季节气温下降，我们会有清爽的早晨和傍晚。（提示：the temperature drops / crisp mornings and evenings）
answer: The temperature drops during this season, and we have crisp mornings and evenings.
exercises.explain: 参考原文第 45、47、53 句。注意"气温下降"用 the temperature drops；"清爽的早晨和傍晚"用 crisp mornings and evenings。

exercises.question: 翻译成英文：感恩节那天人们和家人聚在一起，吃一顿特别丰盛的饭。（提示：get together with / have a big meal）
answer: On Thanksgiving, people get together with their families and have a really big meal.
exercises.explain: 参考原文第 181、185 句。get together with sb 表示"和某人聚会"；have a big meal 是"吃一顿大餐"。

exercises.question: 翻译成英文：从感恩节第二天开始，一直到新年，你到处都能听到圣诞音乐。（提示：starting on… / all the way through to）
answer: Starting on the day after Thanksgiving, all the way through to the new year, you hear Christmas music everywhere.
exercises.explain: 参考原文第 211 句。starting on + 时间点表示"从……开始"；all the way through to 强调一直持续到某个时间。

translations.1: 欢迎收听《听力时间》播客。

translations.7: 你们成为支持者、愿意获取这些加更内容，对我帮助很大。
translations.8: 这真的激励我更努力，为你们、也为你们的听力练习提供更多内容。
translations.10: 计划是每月 15 号上传一期这样的会员加更节目。

translations.22: 希望这个话题对你有意思。
translations.23: 我相信这对你的听力也是很好的练习。

translations.28: 我会把逐字稿的链接加上，方便你查看。
translations.30: 好，我首先要讲的是 autumn 这个词的发音。
translations.31: 注意它不是读“oh”也不是“ow”，而是“aw”。
translations.32: 第一个音节就是“au”tumn，就是这样。
translations.33: 我总听到这个词被读错，所以想特别把它指出来。
translations.34: 英语里说 point that out 或 point something out，意思就是想让你注意到那件事。
translations.35: 我们想让你把注意力放在那件事上。
translations.37: 这样以后你就知道这个词该怎么读了。
translations.38: 就像我在前几期提到的，我们不总是用 autumn 这个词。
translations.39: 这个季节也可以用 fall 这个词。
translations.40: 所以有时候我们说 autumn，有时候说 fall。
translations.41: 好，我们先简单聊聊天气，秋天的天气，然后再讲一些秋季传统。
translations.42: 当然，这个季节就是天气开始有点凉的时候。
translations.43: 对，这个词你在前几期听过。
translations.44: chilly 就是“有点冷”的意思。
translations.47: 早晨和傍晚往往很清爽。
translations.48: 如果你还记得讲季节那期里的这个词，crisp 可以说是 chilly 的另一种说法。
translations.51: 比如我们爱说 a crisp morning（清爽的早晨）。
translations.52: 意思就是有点凉、有点清爽的早晨。
translations.53: 所以秋天当然气温会下降，早晨和傍晚都很清爽，整体上天气就是越来越凉。
translations.54: 秋天还会发生的另一件事，就是颜色会变。
translations.56: 我说的是树叶、花朵、树木之类的颜色。
translations.57: 如果你住的地方四季分明……
translations.58: distinct 就是“不同”的意思，四季分明就是季节各不相同……如果你住在四季分明的地方，你大概会在九月、十月前后看到颜色变化。
translations.59: 比如在美国北部，颜色会从绿色变成黄色、橙色、红色、紫色……这类颜色……还有棕色，对吧。
translations.60: 所以每年这个时候，你会开始看到整片景色都在变化。
translations.61: 你再也看不到夏天的那种绿了。
translations.62: 你开始看到这些秋天的色彩。
translations.63: 大多数美国人都很喜欢秋天树叶变色。
translations.64: 很多人都在期待这件事。
translations.65: 英语里说 look forward to something，意思就是对将来要发生的事感到兴奋、期待。
translations.66: 所以很多美国人期待树叶变色，甚至会专门去漂亮的地方度假旅行，就为了看这些颜色、感受秋天的氛围。
translations.67: 很多人非常喜欢秋天的这一点。
translations.68: 好，我们接着讲美国在这个季节有的一些传统。

translations.71: 如果你从没听说过 pumpkin patch，那就是一个可以带家人去、种着很多南瓜的地方。

translations.79: 这是很适合全家一起做的事，因为孩子们通常喜欢自己决定哪个南瓜最好看，挑南瓜对他们来说是件乐事。
translations.80: 这有点像圣诞节前挑圣诞树：全家人把各种选择比较一番，想象哪棵摆在屋里最好看。
translations.81: 这跟南瓜农场有点类似，你在那里为秋天挑一个自己的南瓜。
translations.82: 在这些南瓜农场里不只有南瓜，还有别的项目。
translations.83: 比如你可以带孩子去坐干草车。

translations.85: 说到牛的时候，我们有时会用 cattle 这个词。

translations.87: 所以我们不说 a cattle。

translations.90: 但在这些南瓜农场里有个项目叫 hay ride（干草车），他们把这些干草铺在货车车厢上。
translations.91: wagon 指那种带轮子的箱式车……通常轮子很大，得靠什么东西来拉。
translations.92: 它没有发动机，自己动不了。
translations.93: 必须由别的东西来拉它。
translations.94: pull 这个词正好是 push（推）的反义词，对吧。
translations.95: 所以你得拉这辆车，它才能动。
translations.96: 坐干草车的时候，通常由拖拉机或某种卡车拉着这辆装满干草的车，你和孩子一般就坐在干草上，绕着南瓜农场兜一圈。

translations.171: 我相信你以前听说过感恩节。
